column1: # Jobs the on-demand CAX41 can run (T047). One row per job, tab-separated.
# Read by infra/hetzner/cax41/spawn.sh on the orchestrator and by
# infra/hetzner/jobs/worker.sh on the worker, so both sides agree on the
# ceiling and the prefixes. A dash means "none". Lines starting with # are
# comments. Keep it LF (jobs/.gitattributes): a CR would end up in the prefix.
# job              name of infra/hetzner/jobs/<job>.sh; spawn.sh <job> [args]
# inputs_prefix    R2 prefix under bucket carta mirrored to /srv/carta/in
# inputs_include   rclone --include patterns, comma-separated; {arg} expands
#                  once per job argument
# outputs_prefix   where spawn.sh promotes the run's out/ after an ok status
# ceiling_h        hard wall-clock ceiling from server create to delete
# expected_h       planning estimate, used for the planned cost only
# needs            setup worker.sh does before the job: python (venv from
#                  requirements.txt + constraints.txt), photos (CPU torch and
#                  OpenCLIP), docker (docker.io from Ubuntu)
# wraps            the local command the job runs, for the reader
job
